1. Nat Neurosci. 2003 Feb;6(2):119-26. doi: 10.1038/nn0203-119.

A framework for consciousness.

Crick F(1), Koch C.

Author information:
(1)Francis Crick is at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies, 10010 N. 
Torrey Pines Road, La Jolla, California 92037, USA.

Here we summarize our present approach to the problem of consciousness. After an 
introduction outlining our general strategy, we describe what is meant by the 
term 'framework' and set it out under ten headings. This framework offers a 
coherent scheme for explaining the neural correlates of (visual) consciousness 
in terms of competing cellular assemblies. Most of the ideas we favor have been 
suggested before, but their combination is original. We also outline some 
general experimental approaches to the problem and, finally, acknowledge some 
relevant aspects of the brain that have been left out of the proposed framework.

DOI: 10.1038/nn0203-119
